subproblem.title: A unit orientation of a subspace has operator norm at most 1
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (Euclid P), and let ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, i.e. a continuous linear functional on the normed space Covector (Euclid P) n of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P (operator norms throughout). If ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P spanning Q such that ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α), then ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 1(c) of the parent proof of representation independence of θH^n⌞M (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(3)): for an orthonormal family τ and any n-covector α, |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖; hence every unit orientation of an n-plane has norm at most 1. Norms: Covector (Euclid P) n = continuous alternating n-linear forms with the operator norm, MultiVector P n = its continuous dual with the operator norm.

1. By the hypothesis IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q choose an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P (spanning Q; the spanning property is not used below) such that either ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α.
2. Fix an n-covector α. Since α is a continuous multilinear map, |α(τ_1,…,τ_n)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏_{i=1}^n ‖τ_i‖ (operator-norm bound, Mathlib ContinuousAlternatingMap.le_opNorm). Orthonormality gives ‖τ_i‖ = 1 for every i, so the product is 1 (for n = 0 it is the empty product 1). Hence |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖.
3. In either sign case of step 1, |ξ(α)| = |±α(τ)| = |α(τ)| ≤ 1·‖α‖.
4. Step 3 holds for every n-covector α and 1 ≥ 0, so by the defining property of the operator norm of the continuous linear functional ξ (Mathlib ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound) we obtain ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1. ∎

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition against GMT.Ch07.Submission, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c; place inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
open scoped ContDiff Pointwise in
theorem unit_orientation_norm_le_one : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rintro P n Q ξ ⟨τ, hτ, -, hξ⟩
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun α => ?_
  have hbound : ‖α τ‖ ≤ ‖α‖ := by
    have := α.le_opNorm τ
    simpa [hτ.1] using this
  rcases hξ with h | h
  · rw [h, one_mul]; exact hbound
  · rw [h, norm_neg, one_mul]; exact hbound
proof_key_steps: Unpack IsUnitOrientationOf: ξ(α) = ±α(τ) for an orthonormal family τ.
|α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏‖τ_i‖ = ‖α‖ by the multilinear operator-norm bound and ‖τ_i‖ = 1.
Hence |ξ(α)| ≤ 1·‖α‖ for all α, so ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 by the operator-norm bound (opNorm_le_bound).

audit.reason: The one-line type exactly matches the prose. Unpacking either orientation sign and applying the multilinear operator-norm bound proves the dual norm bound, including n = 0. The proof is complete and independent of the other children and parent.
